caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture composed primarily of a medium-brown wood with visible grain patterns. The object includes a top section featuring multiple small drawers, each with a round white knob, arranged in two vertical columns of four on either side of a central block. This central block has a pair of taller vertical drawers or compartments flanking a smaller horizontal compartment, all with darker wood inlay details and the horizontal compartment having a darker, outlined decorative pattern. Below this section is a fold-out writing surface or desk panel, also wood-toned, which is currently open and horizontal. Beneath the fold-out surface, there are three large drawers spanning the width of the furniture, each decorated with two ornate, curved handles, and outlined by darker wood inlaid lines following the contours of the drawers’ edges. The piece sits on small, rounded feet and features simple linear and curved details at the corners and sides, which are also highlighted by the wood’s texture and grain. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no other objects or additions visible.
title: Desk
